ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels to 60% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pigmentation patch occupying the distal two-thirds of the left lobe; smaller triangular white patch at the distal tip of the right lobe; dominant low-intensity black pigmentation in the medial/notch region and proximal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 100 pixels from the lobe peak baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency variations (peaks and valleys) measuring 3-7 pixels in amplitude along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the mid-lobe toward the lateral tips, with a steep concave transition toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the black-pigmented areas on both lobes, appearing as high-intensity white or gray lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the entire visible surface and prominent barnacle growth at both lateral tips.
